projects.title: Mentor Externship - University of St. Thomas Law School
projects.description:
Application in which law students are paired with lawyers in the Minneapolis/St. Paul area based on practice areas, academic year, travel and other factors.

Throughout the year the students log various types of events to fulfill their academic requirements for the program. Hours, distinct event types and points of contact with their mentor are tracked throughout the year.

Java EE, Oracle SQL, Spring MVC, JSTL, CSS and jQuery were the technologies used throughout the application.
